name: J5 OBS Multi-Instance
description: Multi-instance OBS Studio host for Pterodactyl. Manages N independent OBS instances with isolated configs, displays, WebSocket, and RTMP within a single Game Server.
author: J5 Studio

variables.name: J5_MANAGER_PORT
variables.description: Port for the J5 Instance Manager API

variables.name: J5_MANAGER_TOKEN
variables.description: Authentication token for the J5 Manager API (min 16 chars)

variables.name: OBS_WEBSOCKET_BASE_PORT
variables.description: Base port for OBS WebSocket (first instance uses this port)

variables.name: OBS_DISPLAY_BASE
variables.description: Base Xvfb display number (first instance uses :BASE+1)

variables.name: OBS_MAX_INSTANCES
variables.description: Maximum number of OBS instances allowed

variables.name: AUTO_RESTART
variables.description: Enable automatic restart on OBS crash (true/false)

variables.name: MAX_RESTARTS
variables.description: Maximum auto-restart attempts per instance before giving up

variables.name: RESTART_DELAY
variables.description: Delay in seconds between restart attempts

variables.name: AUTO_START_INSTANCES
variables.description: Automatically start all instances on server boot (true/false)
